# GeoTIFF Int32 Small

A small single-band GeoTIFF stored as signed 32-bit integers. Tests that raster loaders and downstream code preserve wide integer dtype semantics rather than truncating values to smaller types.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `geotiff_int32_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("geotiff_int32_small")
def test_geotiff_int32_small(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm that signed 32-bit integer rasters open with the correct dtype and preserve their declared numeric storage type through simple reads.

## Risk types covered

- [`dtype_coercion`](../risk/dtype-coercion.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
- `range_truncation`

| `expect_loadable` | yes |

| `expected_epsg` | `32633` |
| `expect_nodata` | yes |
